standards_review.notes: Commit 'EPMCDME-13621: Workspace image inspector tool' matches required EPMCDME-####: Description format.
New file inspect_workspace_image_tool.py includes the Apache 2.0 license header.
All new public functions have explicit parameter and return type annotations.
No hardcoded credentials or sensitive values logged. File access goes through workspace_service, not direct filesystem.

findings.problem: When inspect_request is long enough to exceed the base class token limit, _limit_output_content replaced the InspectWorkspaceImageResponse object with a plain str before _post_process_output_content is called. The isinstance check then hit the else branch, returning (str(output), []) — the image artifact was silently discarded.
findings.impact: The tool would return a truncated text response with an empty artifact list. The LLM would never see the image.
findings.resolution: Added _limit_output_content override that delegates truncation to the base class on output.text only, then re-wraps the result into InspectWorkspaceImageResponse. _post_process_output_content now always receives the expected type and the artifact is preserved even on truncation.

findings.problem: Guard `pending_text is not None` preserved empty-string "" from the first ToolMessage, permanently discarding non-empty text values from subsequent tool messages in the same batch.
findings.impact: The LLM would receive no meaningful analysis request when an earlier artifact carried text="".
findings.resolution: Changed `if text is None` to `if not text` in _extract_image_blocks and `pending_text if pending_text is not None else text` to `pending_text if pending_text else text` in accumulate_artifact. Empty strings no longer shadow subsequent non-empty values.

findings.problem: p.parts spans all ancestors; any file under a directory named like a sandbox system dir anywhere in the path was misclassified as a system file.
findings.impact: Silent data loss: files in user project directories with a matching ancestor name were excluded from processing with no error.
findings.resolution: Changed `any(part in SANDBOX_SYSTEM_DIR_NAMES for part in p.parts)` to `p.parent.name in SANDBOX_SYSTEM_DIR_NAMES`. Only the direct parent directory is now checked.

rationale: All three major patch findings resolved. No story/spec was provided so the acceptance lens was skipped — no-spec round keeps confidence: low. Standards all pass. Deferred: silent no-op on missing execution state in abort_state/finish_state is intentional graceful degradation with no resource leak (confirmed by edge-case lens). Dismissed: WEBP detection edge-case is safe. Diff size: 177+/38- lines across 7 files.
